# Couponscrew

> India's most trusted coupon website — 10,000+ manually verified coupons across 500+ brands, with a 92.4% real-world success rate at checkout.

## About Couponscrew

Couponscrew is an Indian coupon website, founded in 2025 with a mission to help Indian shoppers save money online by providing verified, up-to-date coupon codes and discount deals in one place. Couponscrew launched with 50 brand partners and 500 verified codes, and reached 10,000 users within three months.

Couponscrew helps Indian shoppers find verified, working coupon codes, deals, and offers without wasting time on expired listings. Every coupon code is manually tested by a real person before it goes live — the platform does not publish and hope, it verifies first. Codes are tested at checkout and expired or non-working codes are removed daily, ensuring only active deals are shown. The guiding principle: two verified codes beat 47 expired ones every time — Couponscrew optimises for the shopper's time, not listing count.

The platform is completely free to use for shoppers and is supported by affiliate commissions earned from brands when a shopper makes a purchase using a coupon code or deal — at no extra cost to the shopper. Couponscrew never sells user data.

Over 50,000 shoppers use Couponscrew to save on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Swiggy, Zomato, Pepperfry, and 500+ other brands across fashion, electronics, food & grocery, travel, home & kitchen, and more.

## Store Categories

Couponscrew organizes its 500+ partner stores across these categories: Fashion, Beauty, Exercise & Fitness, Home & Kitchen, Clothing & Accessories, Electronics, Food & Grocery, Travel, Education, Entertainment, Finance, Web Hosting, Health, Sports, Software, Gaming, Jewellery, Eyewear, Furniture. Browse the full directory at https://www.couponscrew.com/stores/categories.
